title: MTS Progressive Mathematics Curriculum Backbone — Grades 1–12
purpose: Concept-first vertical curriculum backbone used to align long-term progression before attaching standards or district pacing.

basis: User-provided MTS curriculum analysis structure and sample
Previously agreed Grade 1–12 progressive master view in this project
Existing local NC standards cache and CCS pacing cache used as supporting context only
provenance.note: Conceptual progression layer. CCS pacing selects active concepts; NC standards are attached in a later enrichment layer.

vertical_spines: Quantity → Number → Operation → Unknown → Variable → Equation → Relationship → Function → Function Family → Rate of Change
Equal Parts → Fractions → Ratios → Proportions → Slope → Linear Functions → Nonlinear Functions → Instantaneous Rate of Change
Shape → Measurement → Area → Coordinate Geometry → Similarity → Trigonometry → Analytic Geometry
Sort/Count → Graphs → Distributions → Sampling/Probability → Bivariate Data → Regression → Statistical Inference
